items.title: Saudi Arabia’s Diriyah Scraps $191 Million Hotel Build
items.why: Signals giga-project retrenchment that could thin the Saudi luxury hotel pipeline for partner planning.
items.summary_ai: Diriyah has cancelled a $191 million hotel contract without explaining why, the first Saudi hotel project known to be pulled since the Houthi strikes on Riyadh.
items.take: Signals giga-project retrenchment that could thin the Saudi luxury hotel pipeline for partner planning.
